loop.meaning: Short for 'baby girl', used ironically or affectionately on chats and reels to address friends or romantic interests.
loop.example: Don't worry about the exam, bbg, you'll pass easily.

loop.meaning: A dynamic where one partner constantly craves closeness while the other pulls away, triggering a painful push-and-pull cycle.

loop.meaning: A viral joke format about acting very modest, mindful, and respectful, usually delivered with extreme mock-seriousness.

loop.meaning: Acting shady, unreliable, or trying to trick someone out of money, time, or favors.

loop.meaning: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder; a neurodevelopmental condition causing trouble with focus, organization, and impulse control.

india.text: Delhi Police detained key Cockroach Janata Party leaders and hundreds of protesters ahead of a planned demonstration at Jantar Mantar.
The Reserve Bank of India opened a special dollar window for public sector oil companies starting October 12 to manage rising global oil prices.
Elon Musk criticized Indian business interests and alleged a monopoly in a public escalation over Starlink's satellite communication service rollout.
A parliamentary panel report revealed that the National Testing Agency has 16 of its 39 permanent posts vacant.
The Union government proposed tighter advertising curbs on prescription-only drugs for pharmacies and wholesalers to prevent unauthorized promotion.
Eight BJP and two Samajwadi Party candidates were elected unopposed to the Rajya Sabha from Uttar Pradesh.
A Kuki woman was killed in crossfire during a bunker demolition drive in Manipur's Kamjong district, prompting local restrictions.
India strongly countered Pakistan's remarks concerning Jammu and Kashmir during a session at the United Nations.

world.text: Former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize for her work advancing international law.
Donald Trump announced an agreement to purchase Russian diesel, drawing sharp condemnation from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
The United States imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, prompting fierce criticism from member states over undermining the international rule of law.
A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama, prompting authorities to declare a disaster following structural damage across the region.
Hurricane Isaias made landfall in Florida as the first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season, threatening severe flooding along the Gulf coast.
Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te announced an increase in defence spending aimed at deterring military aggression across the Taiwan Strait.

onThisDay.text: R. K. Narayan, one of the greatest Indian novelists who brought Indian writing to the global stage with works like Malgudi Days, was born.
Jagjit Singh, the legendary Indian singer-songwriter who revived the popularity of the ghazal, passed away.
Vidyasagar Setu, India's longest cable-stayed bridge, opened to significantly improve connectivity between Kolkata and Howrah after two decades of construction.
The Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty went into effect, prohibiting all nuclear weapons test detonations except underground ones to curb environmental radiation.
The Wuchang Uprising began the Xinhai Revolution, leading to the collapse of the Qing dynasty and the birth of the Republic of China.
